name: main-refresh
description: Keep a local main checkout equal to origin/main for people who do their branch work in Claude worktrees: decide safety before acting, fast-forward only when no local file is touched, and park local work (dirty files, colliding untracked files, local-only commits) losslessly on a wip/main-<date>-<n> branch. Never stashes, never deletes a lock, never resets without parking first.
